security_spec.violation_condition: QEMU emulates a write to the D (delegate) bit in an M-mode `eisourcecfg` indirect-CSR without zeroing the entire 11-bit source configuration when the Ssaclic extension is not present in the hart's feature set, violating the WARL constraint that 'writing '1' to the D (delegate) bit of an interrupt's source configuration causes the interrupt's entire source configuration to be set to zero instead'
security_spec.summary: M-mode eisourcecfg D-bit write must atomically zero full source config when Ssaclic absent; partial WARL enforcement creates unauthorized interrupt delegation to non-existent S-mode interrupt file

findings.finding: APLIC sourcecfg write WARL logic correctly zeros the entire configuration when D bit is written on a domain with no children (line 744-745), and properly masks SM/SRCIDX fields based on D bit state (lines 747-751). This is APLIC MMIO, not the SMACLIC eisourcecfg indirect-CSR path described in the security spec.

The csrind dispatch in rmw_xireg_csrind only handles CD (counter delegation, 0x40-0x5f) and CTR (0x200+) ranges. There is no eisourcecfg range dispatch. Unimplemented select ranges raise ILLEGAL_INST per spec recommendation. This is correct behavior — SMACLIC/SSACLIC are not implemented in this QEMU version.

iselect write WARL masking correctly caps at ISELECT_MASK_SXCSRIND (0xfff, 12 bits) when smcsrind/sscsrind is present, or ISELECT_MASK_AIA (0x1ff, 9 bits) when only AIA is present. This prevents writing select values >= 0x1000, which means eisourcecfg range (0x1000-0x1fff) can never be selected. The vulnerability path is structurally blocked.

The AIA range check covers only IPRIO (0x30-0x3f) and IMSIC (0x70-0xff) ranges. IMSIC sourcecfg (0x1000-0x1fff) is outside these bounds and will fall through to rmw_xireg_csrind, which raises ILLEGAL_INST. No eisourcecfg emulation exists.

findings.finding: rmw_xireg correctly gates csrind access on ext_smcsrind OR ext_sscsrind. Without these extensions, only the AIA range is accessible. Since SMACLIC is not implemented, this gate is irrelevant to the security spec's concern — the full csrind path still lacks eisourcecfg handling.
